name: High Stakes
summary: Bertrand Ironbrow needs wood bundles brought from Turner's Logging Camp to Farholde Keep. The lumber will help the keep finish its gate as orcs grow more feisty.

sections.title: Wood for the Keep
sections.body: Bertrand Ironbrow needs lumber for Farholde Keep, where people are building amid a warzone filled with orcs and cultists. You are asked to bring bundles from Turner's Logging Camp because dangerous roads have slowed the shipments. The keep's gate is still being built, and the orcs are growing more feisty.

faq.answer: Bertrand Ironbrow needs the wood at Farholde Keep.

faq.q: Where do the bundles come from?
faq.answer: The bundles come from Turner's Logging Camp, northwest of Farholde Keep.
Dangerous roads have slowed the lumber shipments from the mill to the northwest.
The wood is for Farholde Keep, where it may help finish the gate.
Crocodiles and murlocs are along the way from the keep to the mill.
